rulingTitle: Quoted old paths become null and are skipped before the unreadable check; a real-git probe moving bypass() between repeated branches in f\t.js still returned equivalent=true.

action.reason: Not safe to ship: quoted old paths become null with unreadable=true, but uniquelyLocated skips null paths before checking unreadable. Matching diff identities can therefore bypass location verification and skip review of a changed patch.

rationale: Confirmed directly in oldPathOf and uniquelyLocated. This violates the requirement that changed patches receive full review. Reject unreadable paths before skipping absent paths, and add a quoted-filename repeated-context regression asserting equivalence=false. Existing tests cover repeated context and failed blob reads, but not this parsing bypass.
